messages:
Alex: Heads up — proposal for rollout 'guard' API and console UX to reduce noisy canary alerts. TL;DR: add min_sample_size, grace_period, and a metric-stability check before triggering a hard rollback.
Maria: +1 on min_sample_size. we've seen p95 spikes from 3 noisy requests break canaries.
Ajay: curious about the metric-stability check. can you sketch the heuristic?
Alex: idea: require at least two consecutive windows (default 2 x 5m) where delta > threshold before firing. also attach a sample_size filter and require traffic >= 2% or >= 100 reqs, whichever larger.
Reena: what about percentiles vs mean? ops prefers p95 + error_rate, product wants mean latency shown in the UI.
Kate (devex): console UX: we can show a small "health panel" with baseline vs canary p50/p95/error_rate + sparkline. expand for slices. defaults should be conservative.
Samuel: API debate: strict typed guard object vs composable rule language. typed object easier for SDKs and validation; rule language better for power users.
Ajay: prefer typed object with an optional 'advanced_rule' field that accepts a CEL-like expression. then console shows a simple builder for most users.
Alex: exactly. proposal config:
```
{
  "guard": {
    "min_sample_size": 100,
    "grace_period_secs": 300,
    "consecutive_windows": 2,
    "window_secs": 300,
    "metrics": [
      {"name":"p95_latency_ms","delta_pct":20},
      {"name":"error_rate","delta_abs":0.01}
    ],
    "traffic_threshold_pct": 2,
    "rollback_on_violation": true,
    "advanced_rule": "optional CEL expression"
  }
}
```
Maria: can we surface a "risky but continue" action in UI so SREs can ignore non-actionable minor violations? maybe allow a manual override for minor deltas.
Reena: also add a 'noise_suppression' toggle that requires the delta to be persistent after removing top and bottom 1% outliers.
Kate (devex): UX note: show a suggested guard profile (low/medium/high) with prefilled values plus explainers and cost of false positives.
Alex: integration notes: telemetry must tag canary traffic and baseline traffic, plus route metadata (route_id, model, region) for slice drilldowns. we should avoid exposing raw PII.
slo-bot: [ALERT SIMULATION] guard check simulated: p95 latency delta 22% at 3% traffic; sample_size 120; would trigger roll_forward=false :eyes:
Samuel: Can we have a 'dry_run' mode where the guard only reports violations but doesn't rollback? very useful for initial tuning.
Ajay: +1. also we need audit logs for manual overrides and who clicked continue.
Maria: agree. last ask: default to conservative (no auto rollback) for public tenants, auto-rollback allowed in dedicated/internal only.
Alex: ok action items: 1) I'll land the typed schema PR with advanced_rule optional. 2) Kate will mock console variants. 3) Ajay + Reena to prototype telemetry tags and stability check code. 4) Samuel to add dry_run + audit events. I'll ping infra for data retention impact.
Kate (devex): mock ETA end of week. I'll attach mock screenshots in thread when ready.
Reena: I'll add tests for sample_size and consecutive_windows heuristics. we should also log the windowed statistics so we can debug flakiness.
Samuel: thanks everyone — sounds actionable. :thumbsup:
Alex: will follow up with PR link and a short doc outlining guard profiles.
